% Expression plots on a logarithmic x direction are sampled logarithmically
% over `domain` (manual; behaviour Z11, found by the generator fuzz).
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{semilogxaxis}[xlabel={$x$}]
\addplot+[domain=0.2:20, samples=7] {sqrt(x)};
\addplot+[domain=0.5:8, samples=11, mark=none] {3 - 0.4*x};
\end{semilogxaxis}
\end{tikzpicture}
